FOUNDATIONAL: Build Mission Statement & Founder Profile into Mission Control
acpSessions.description: Mission Control must reflect the mission statement, founder profile, founder's long-term objectives, and the family enterprise model. This is the foundational identity layer that all other command layers reference.

acpSessions.task: FOUNDATIONAL: Model Ownership & Entity Structure (LLCs, LPs, Trusts, Holdings)
acpSessions.description: Build structured representation of all companies, holding companies, LPs, LLCs, trust relationships, ownership percentages, and property ownership. This is the data backbone for Entity Map, Finance Command, and Risk Command.

acpSessions.task: FOUNDATIONAL: Define Family Enterprise Model & Generational Planning Framework
acpSessions.description: Define the structure for how family enterprise stewardship, wealth compounding goals, and generational transfer planning are tracked and managed within Mission Control.

acpSessions.task: CMD-1: Executive Overview — Top-Level Org Dashboard
acpSessions.description: Build a top-level dashboard showing the most important metrics, priorities, risks, opportunities, and current actions across the entire organization. Colby should see at a glance: state of business, state of holdings, state of cash/capital, state of active initiatives, state of risk, and highest-leverage next actions.

acpSessions.task: CMD-2: Entity Map — Companies, Holdings, Trusts & Ownership Visualization
acpSessions.description: Build a structured and visual map of companies, holdings, LPs, LLCs, trust relationships, ownership percentages, and property ownership. Must show entity relationships, ownership structures, and how assets flow between entities.

acpSessions.task: CMD-3: Revenue Command — Revenue by Business, Growth Initiatives & Pipeline
acpSessions.description: Build a view of revenue by business, growth initiatives, pipeline drivers, trends, bottlenecks, and current priorities affecting top-line growth. Track revenue growth initiatives and what is performing vs what is broken.

acpSessions.task: CMD-4: Expense & Efficiency Command — Vendor Spend, Margin Leakage & Waste Reduction
acpSessions.description: Build a system for identifying expense categories, vendor spend, inefficiencies, margin leakage, duplicate costs, and opportunities to reduce waste. Support expense reduction initiatives and margin management.

acpSessions.task: CMD-5: Cash Flow & Finance Command — Position, Forecasts & Obligations
acpSessions.description: Build a central view for cash position, inflows, outflows, obligations, forecasts, and near-term financial pressure points. Business and personal finance visibility where appropriate. Where capital is going must be clear.

acpSessions.task: CMD-6: Investing & Capital Allocation Command — Deployment, Returns & Strategy
acpSessions.description: Build a place to track investment decisions, capital deployment, returns, strategic rationale, ownership value, and future opportunities. Support capital allocation decisions and long-term wealth building.

acpSessions.task: CMD-7: Operations & Automation Command — Workflows, Delegation & Founder Burden Reduction
acpSessions.description: Build a view of workflows, automations, delegated tasks, recurring processes, system dependencies, and places where founder involvement can be reduced. Support autonomous operations and reduce founder drag.

acpSessions.task: CMD-8: Strategic Initiatives Command — Major Goals, Buildouts & Execution Tracking
acpSessions.description: Build a place for major goals, current buildouts, project execution, blockers, timelines, and outcomes. Track strategic initiatives across the organization with clear visibility into what matters and what is changing.

acpSessions.task: CMD-9: Risk & Exposure Command — Legal, Financial, Tax & Concentration Risk Monitoring
acpSessions.description: Build a surface for legal, operational, financial, tax, concentration, and execution risks that need monitoring and mitigation. Surface where risk is building and where leverage can be created.

acpSessions.task: CMD-10: Memory & Decision Command — Institutional Knowledge, Decision Logs & Directives
acpSessions.description: Build a persistent record of major decisions, assumptions, directives, structural notes, and institutional knowledge that OpenClaw should preserve and use. This is the organizational memory system.

acpSessions.task: DESIGN: Build KPI System Across All Businesses & Entities
acpSessions.description: Design and implement key performance indicators spanning all operating businesses, holding companies, real estate assets, and strategic initiatives. KPIs should surface what is performing, what is broken, and highest-leverage next actions.

acpSessions.task: DESIGN: Rethink Mission Control Navigation & Information Architecture
acpSessions.description: Redesign Mission Control navigation to support the 10 command layers. Current sidebar reflects a tech platform dashboard — it needs to reflect an organizational operating system. Organize information, visualize relationships, surface insights, and reduce blind spots.

acpSessions.task: INFRA: Connect QuickBooks Data Pipeline for Finance Commands
acpSessions.description: Wire QuickBooks OAuth connection (already started) into Mission Control to power Revenue Command, Expense Command, and Cash Flow Command with real financial data. P&L, cash position, inflows/outflows, vendor spend all come from here.

acpSessions.task: RESEARCH: Digital Asset & DeFi Investment Tracking Framework for Capital Allocation Command
acpSessions.description: Research and design a framework for tracking cryptocurrency holdings, DeFi positions, yield farming, staking rewards, and on-chain portfolio value. This feeds into CMD-6 (Investing & Capital Allocation). Include data sources, APIs, and recommended tracking metrics.

acpSessions.task: RESEARCH: Market Conditions & Macro Indicators Dashboard Design for Executive Overview
acpSessions.description: Research key macroeconomic indicators (interest rates, inflation, GDP, employment, housing) and design how they should be displayed in the Executive Overview. Identify reliable data sources and update frequencies.

acpSessions.task: RESEARCH: Portfolio Analytics & Equity Tracking Module for Investing Command
acpSessions.description: Design the stock/equity tracking module for CMD-6: position sizing, cost basis, unrealized P&L, sector allocation, dividend tracking. Recommend data APIs and visualization approaches.

acpSessions.task: RESEARCH: SEO & Digital Presence Monitoring for Revenue Command
acpSessions.description: Research how to track and surface SEO performance, email marketing metrics, and digital presence health across all businesses. Design KPIs and data sources for the Revenue Command layer.

acpSessions.task: RESEARCH: Marketing Performance Dashboard Design for Revenue Command
acpSessions.description: Design the marketing performance view for Revenue Command — campaign ROI, lead pipeline, conversion funnels, ad spend efficiency, brand awareness metrics across all businesses. Coordinate with sub-team (Echo, Spark, Pulse, etc).

acpSessions.task: RESEARCH: Social Media & Community Analytics for Revenue Command
acpSessions.description: Research social media analytics integration — engagement rates, follower growth, sentiment analysis, community health metrics. Design how this data feeds into Revenue Command and the Executive Overview.

acpSessions.task: RESEARCH: Conversion Optimization & Growth Metrics for Revenue Command
acpSessions.description: Research growth engineering metrics — funnel conversion rates, A/B test results, landing page performance, lead-to-close ratios. Design the growth analytics module for Revenue Command.

acpSessions.task: RESEARCH: Content Strategy & Editorial Calendar Module for Strategic Initiatives Command
acpSessions.description: Design a content strategy tracking module — editorial calendar, content pipeline, publication schedule, content performance metrics. This supports CMD-8 (Strategic Initiatives) for content-driven businesses.

acpSessions.task: RESEARCH: Brand Health & PR Monitoring Module for Risk Command
acpSessions.description: Research brand reputation monitoring, PR coverage tracking, sentiment analysis, and crisis detection. Design how brand/PR risk feeds into CMD-9 (Risk & Exposure Command).

acpSessions.task: RESEARCH: Competitive Intelligence & Market Position Module for Executive Overview
acpSessions.description: Design the competitive intelligence module — market position tracking, competitor monitoring, industry trends, SWOT analysis. This feeds into the Executive Overview and Strategic Initiatives Command.

acpSessions.task: QA: Define Testing & Validation Framework for All Mission Control Command Layers
acpSessions.description: Design the QA and validation framework for the 10 Mission Control command layers. Define data quality checks, accuracy validation, dashboard testing criteria, and automated monitoring for each command view.
